note: A day designated by law as a public holiday, when some businesses or government offices close; rules and dates vary by jurisdiction.

senses.m: A day designated by law as a public holiday, when some businesses or government offices close
senses.pat: a legal holiday in · observe a legal holiday · federal legal holiday
ex: The courthouse will close for the legal holiday.
Tòa án sẽ đóng cửa vào ngày nghỉ lễ theo luật định.
The date is a legal holiday in that state.
Ngày đó là ngày nghỉ lễ theo luật tại bang đó.

note: A unique number printed on a license, such as a driver’s or professional license; spelling license is US, licence noun in British English.

senses.m: A unique number printed on a license, such as a driver’s or professional license
senses.pat: enter a license number · verify the license number · driver’s license number
ex: Enter your license number to renew the permit.
Nhập số giấy phép để gia hạn giấy phép.
The officer recorded the vehicle’s license number.
Cảnh sát ghi lại biển số xe.

note: An elected or appointed official who may serve as deputy governor or perform other duties; role varies by state or country.

senses.m: An elected or appointed official who may serve as deputy governor or perform other duties
senses.pat: the lieutenant governor of · elect a lieutenant governor · lieutenant-governor duties
ex: The lieutenant governor presided over the state senate.
Phó thống đốc chủ trì thượng viện bang.
She ran for lieutenant governor in the election.
Bà tranh cử chức phó thống đốc trong cuộc bầu cử.

note: A prison sentence for the remainder of a person’s life, though parole eligibility and legal meaning differ by jurisdiction.

senses.m: A prison sentence for the remainder of a person’s life, though parole eligibility and legal meaning differ by jurisdiction
senses.pat: receive a life sentence · serve a life sentence · a life sentence without parole
ex: The judge imposed a life sentence for the crime.
Thẩm phán tuyên án tù chung thân cho tội danh đó.
The law allows parole review for some life sentences.
Luật cho phép xem xét ân xá đối với một số bản án chung thân.

note: A firefly, especially in US English; the insect produces light through bioluminescence.

senses.m: A firefly, especially in US English
senses.pat: a lightning bug glows · catch lightning bugs · lightning-bug season
ex: Lightning bugs flickered over the field at dusk.
Đom đóm lập lòe trên cánh đồng lúc chạng vạng.
The children watched a lightning bug glow in a jar before releasing it.
Bọn trẻ ngắm một con đom đóm phát sáng trong lọ rồi thả nó đi.

note: A woodland flowering plant, Convallaria majalis, with small fragrant bell-shaped flowers; all parts are poisonous if ingested.

senses.m: A woodland flowering plant, Convallaria majalis, with small fragrant bell-shaped flowers
senses.pat: a sprig of lily of the valley · lily-of-the-valley flowers · grow in shade
ex: Lily of the valley bloomed beneath the trees.
Hoa linh lan nở dưới những tán cây.
The florist warned that the plant is poisonous if eaten.
Người bán hoa cảnh báo cây có độc nếu ăn phải.

note: The organization and supervision of employees who report through a direct management hierarchy; exact usage varies by workplace.

senses.m: The organization and supervision of employees who report through a direct management hierarchy
senses.pat: line-management responsibility · report through line management · line manager
ex: Line management is responsible for staff development.
Quản lý trực tiếp chịu trách nhiệm phát triển nhân viên.
The issue was referred to her line manager.
Vấn đề được chuyển cho quản lý trực tiếp của cô.

note: A flat brown spot that commonly appears on sun-exposed skin with age; also called an age spot or solar lentigo. It is not caused by liver disease.

senses.m: A flat brown spot that commonly appears on sun-exposed skin with age
senses.pat: a liver spot on the hand · treat/remove liver spots · age spots
ex: The dermatologist checked a new spot on his hand.
Bác sĩ da liễu kiểm tra một đốm mới trên tay ông.
Liver spots are usually linked to sun exposure, not the liver.
Đốm đồi mồi thường liên quan đến phơi nắng, không phải gan.

note: A person who lends money at illegally high interest rates or uses threats to collect repayment.

senses.m: A person who lends money at illegally high interest rates or uses threats to collect repayment
senses.pat: borrow from a loan shark · a loan-sharking operation · loan-shark interest
ex: He borrowed from a loan shark and faced threats over repayment.
Anh vay tiền của kẻ cho vay nặng lãi và bị đe dọa đòi nợ.
The investigation targeted an illegal loan shark.
Cuộc điều tra nhắm vào một kẻ cho vay nặng lãi trái phép.

note: A local government body responsible for services in a defined area; exact structure and powers differ by country.

senses.m: A local government body responsible for services in a defined area
senses.pat: the local authority provides · contact your local authority · local-authority services
ex: The local authority maintains the public parks.
Chính quyền địa phương bảo trì các công viên công cộng.
Residents contacted the local authority about road repairs.
Cư dân liên hệ chính quyền địa phương về việc sửa đường.

note: A room with lockers where people change or store belongings, especially in schools, gyms, or sports facilities; British English often changing room.

senses.m: A room with lockers where people change or store belongings, especially in schools, gyms, or sports facilities
senses.pat: a gym locker room · change in the locker room · locker-room talk
ex: She left her bag in the locker room.
Cô để túi trong phòng thay đồ.
The coach addressed the team in the locker room.
Huấn luyện viên nói chuyện với cả đội trong phòng thay đồ.

note: A small building made from logs, often associated with rural or historical settings.

senses.m: A small building made from logs, often associated with rural or historical settings
senses.pat: build a log cabin · stay in a log cabin · a rustic log cabin
ex: They rented a log cabin beside the lake.
Họ thuê một căn nhà gỗ bên hồ.
The settlers built a log cabin from nearby pine trees.
Những người định cư dựng căn nhà gỗ từ cây thông gần đó.

note: A written method for dividing large numbers, performed step by step.

senses.m: A written method for dividing large numbers, performed step by step
senses.pat: do/use long division · teach long division · a long-division problem
ex: The teacher showed the class how to solve the problem by long division.
Giáo viên chỉ cả lớp cách giải phép chia dài.
She checked her long division with multiplication.
Cô kiểm tra phép chia dài bằng phép nhân.

note: A romantic or sexual relationship, often secret or outside marriage; figuratively, a strong enthusiasm for something.

senses.m: A romantic or sexual relationship, often secret or outside marriage
senses.pat: have a love affair with · a secret love affair · a love affair with music
ex: The novel tells the story of a secret love affair.
Cuốn tiểu thuyết kể câu chuyện về một mối tình bí mật.
The chef has had a lifelong love affair with Italian food.
Đầu bếp say mê ẩm thực Ý suốt đời.

note: A powered machine used to cut, shape, or finish materials such as metal or wood.

senses.m: A powered machine used to cut, shape, or finish materials such as metal or wood
senses.pat: operate a machine tool · machine-tool industry · precision machine tools
ex: The factory uses a machine tool to cut metal parts.
Nhà máy dùng máy công cụ để cắt các chi tiết kim loại.
Modern machine tools can be controlled by computers.
Máy công cụ hiện đại có thể được điều khiển bằng máy tính.

note: The common name for bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE), a fatal disease of cattle; variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease is a rare human condition associated with exposure to BSE.

senses.m: The common name for bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE), a fatal disease of cattle
senses.pat: an outbreak of mad cow disease · BSE testing · mad-cow disease controls
ex: The country introduced testing after a mad cow disease outbreak.
Quốc gia áp dụng xét nghiệm sau đợt bùng phát bệnh bò điên.
Officials strengthened controls to limit BSE transmission.
Giới chức tăng cường kiểm soát để hạn chế lây truyền BSE.

note: A system of buying goods by ordering them remotely, traditionally by post or catalog and now often online.

senses.m: A system of buying goods by ordering them remotely, traditionally by post or catalog and now often online
senses.pat: buy something by mail order · a mail-order catalog · mail-order business
ex: She bought the book through a mail-order catalog.
Cô mua cuốn sách qua danh mục đặt hàng qua thư.
The company began as a mail-order business.
Công ty khởi đầu là một doanh nghiệp bán hàng qua thư.

note: A train carrying mail and sometimes sorting it while traveling; historically important in countries with rail-post systems.

senses.m: A train carrying mail and sometimes sorting it while traveling
senses.pat: a mail train carries · sort letters on a mail train · mail-train service
ex: The mail train delivered letters to remote towns.
Chuyến tàu bưu chính chuyển thư đến các thị trấn xa.
Workers sorted the post aboard the overnight mail train.
Nhân viên phân loại thư trên chuyến tàu bưu chính chạy đêm.

note: The principal street in a town or neighborhood; informal, especially North American.

senses.m: The principal street in a town or neighborhood
senses.pat: on the main drag · drive down the main drag · shops along the main drag
ex: The café is on the main drag through town.
Quán cà phê nằm trên con phố chính xuyên qua thị trấn.
They walked along the main drag after dinner.
Họ đi dạo trên phố chính sau bữa tối.

note: A top-level professional sports league, especially in North America; figuratively, a highly important or advanced level.

senses.m: A top-level professional sports league, especially in North America
senses.pat: play in the major leagues · major-league baseball · move to the major leagues
ex: She hopes to play in the major leagues one day.
Cô hy vọng một ngày nào đó được thi đấu ở giải chuyên nghiệp hàng đầu.
The company is now competing in the major league of software firms.
Công ty hiện cạnh tranh ở đẳng cấp cao nhất trong ngành phần mềm.
